The '''Tellanroaeg system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Gaulus sector/Legends|Gaulus sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Gaulus" /> that contained the astronomical object [[Tellanroaeg]].<ref name="RotS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' place the Tellanroaeg system on the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] within grid square S-17.<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="TEGtW" /> That territory corresponds to a section of the [[Gaulus sector/Legends|Gaulus sector]], according to [https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors]. However, the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] instead places the Tellanroaeg system in the [[Hunnoverrs sector/Legends|Hunnoverrs sector]], which this article assumes to be erroneous.<ref name="Gaulus" /> Accordingly, [[Jason Fry]], author of ''The Essential Atlas'' and its Online Companion, later moved the Tellanroaeg system from the Hunnoverrs sector to the Gaulus sectors in the system appendix of the [[2025]] [[Canon]] [[Star Systems of the Galaxy]].<ref name="Appendix">{{GalaxyMapAppendix}}</ref>
